TagList.doc: A list of tags. For more information, see Tagging Amazon RDS resources in the Amazon RDS User Guide or Tagging Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS resources in the Amazon Aurora User Guide .

item.doc: Metadata assigned to an Amazon RDS resource consisting of a key-value pair. For more information, see Tagging Amazon RDS resources in the Amazon RDS User Guide or Tagging Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS resources in the Amazon Aurora User Guide .

Key.doc: A key is the required name of the tag. The string value can be from 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and can't be prefixed with aws: or rds: . The string can only contain only the set of Unicode letters, digits, white-space, '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@' (Java regex: "^([\\p{L}\\p{Z}\\p{N}_.:/=+\\-@]*)$").

Value.doc: A value is the optional value of the tag. The string value can be from 1 to 256 Unicode characters in length and can't be prefixed with aws: or rds: . The string can only contain only the set of Unicode letters, digits, white-space, '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@' (Java regex: "^([\\p{L}\\p{Z}\\p{N}_.:/=+\\-@]*)$").

OriginalSnapshotCreateTime.doc: Specifies the time of the CreateDBSnapshot operation in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Doesn't change when the snapshot is copied.

SnapshotDatabaseTime.doc: The timestamp of the most recent transaction applied to the database that you're backing up. Thus, if you restore a snapshot, SnapshotDatabaseTime is the most recent transaction in the restored DB instance. In contrast, originalSnapshotCreateTime specifies the system time that the snapshot completed. If you back up a read replica, you can determine the replica lag by comparing SnapshotDatabaseTime with originalSnapshotCreateTime. For example, if originalSnapshotCreateTime is two hours later tha…

SnapshotTarget.doc: Specifies where manual snapshots are stored: Amazon Web Services Outposts or the Amazon Web Services Region.

StorageThroughput.doc: Specifies the storage throughput for the DB snapshot.

DBSystemId.doc: The Oracle system identifier (SID), which is the name of the Oracle database instance that manages your database files. The Oracle SID is also the name of your CDB.

DedicatedLogVolume.doc: Indicates whether the DB instance has a dedicated log volume (DLV) enabled.

MultiTenant.doc: Indicates whether the snapshot is of a DB instance using the multi-tenant configuration (TRUE) or the single-tenant configuration (FALSE).

rds.DescribeDBSubnetGroups.doc: Returns a list of DBSubnetGroup descriptions. If a DBSubnetGroupName is specified, the list will contain only the descriptions of the specified DBSubnetGroup. For an overview of CIDR ranges, go to the Wikipedia Tutorial .

output.doc: Contains the result of a successful invocation of the DescribeDBSubnetGroups action.

Marker.doc: An optional pagination token provided by a previous request. If this parameter is specified, the response includes only records beyond the marker, up to the value specified by MaxRecords .

item.doc: Contains the details of an Amazon RDS DB subnet group. This data type is used as a response element in the DescribeDBSubnetGroups action.

DBSubnetGroupName.doc: The name of the DB subnet group.

DBSubnetGroupDescription.doc: Provides the description of the DB subnet group.

VpcId.doc: Provides the VpcId of the DB subnet group.

SubnetGroupStatus.doc: Provides the status of the DB subnet group.

Subnets.doc: Contains a list of Subnet elements.

item.doc: This data type is used as a response element for the DescribeDBSubnetGroups operation.

SubnetAvailabilityZone.doc: Contains Availability Zone information. This data type is used as an element in the OrderableDBInstanceOption data type.

Name.doc: The name of the Availability Zone.

SubnetOutpost.doc: If the subnet is associated with an Outpost, this value specifies the Outpost. For more information about RDS on Outposts, see Amazon RDS on Amazon Web Services Outposts in the Amazon RDS User Guide.

Arn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Outpost.

DBSubnetGroupArn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the DB subnet group.

SupportedNetworkTypes.doc: The network type of the DB subnet group. Valid values: IPV4 DUAL A DBSubnetGroup can support only the IPv4 protocol or the IPv4 and the IPv6 protocols ( DUAL ). For more information, see Working with a DB instance in a VPC in the Amazon RDS User Guide.

OptionGroupName.doc: Specifies the name of the option group.

OptionGroupDescription.doc: Provides a description of the option group.

EngineName.doc: Indicates the name of the engine that this option group can be applied to.

MajorEngineVersion.doc: Indicates the major engine version associated with this option group.

Options.doc: Indicates what options are available in the option group.

item.doc: The details of an option.

Persistent.doc: Indicates whether this option is persistent.

Permanent.doc: Indicates whether this option is permanent.

Port.doc: If required, the port configured for this option to use.

OptionSettings.doc: The option settings for this option.

item.doc: Option settings are the actual settings being applied or configured for that option. It is used when you modify an option group or describe option groups. For example, the NATIVE_NETWORK_ENCRYPTION option has a setting called SQLNET.ENCRYPTION_SERVER that can have several different values.

Name.doc: The name of the option that has settings that you can set.

Value.doc: The current value of the option setting.

DefaultValue.doc: The default value of the option setting.

Description.doc: The description of the option setting.

ApplyType.doc: The DB engine specific parameter type.

DataType.doc: The data type of the option setting.

AllowedValues.doc: The allowed values of the option setting.

IsModifiable.doc: Indicates whether the option setting can be modified from the default.

IsCollection.doc: Indicates whether the option setting is part of a collection.

DBSecurityGroupMemberships.doc: If the option requires access to a port, then this DB security group allows access to the port.

item.doc: This data type is used as a response element in the following actions: ModifyDBInstance RebootDBInstance RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot RestoreDBInstanceToPointInTime

DBSecurityGroupName.doc: The name of the DB security group.

Status.doc: The status of the DB security group.

VpcSecurityGroupMemberships.doc: If the option requires access to a port, then this VPC security group allows access to the port.

item.doc: This data type is used as a response element for queries on VPC security group membership.

VpcSecurityGroupId.doc: The name of the VPC security group.

Status.doc: The membership status of the VPC security group. Currently, the only valid status is active .

AllowsVpcAndNonVpcInstanceMemberships.doc: Indicates whether this option group can be applied to both VPC and non-VPC instances. The value true indicates the option group can be applied to both VPC and non-VPC instances.

VpcId.doc: If AllowsVpcAndNonVpcInstanceMemberships is false , this field is blank. If AllowsVpcAndNonVpcInstanceMemberships is true and this field is blank, then this option group can be applied to both VPC and non-VPC instances. If this field contains a value, then this option group can only be applied to instances that are in the VPC indicated by this field.

OptionGroupArn.doc: Specifies the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the option group.

SourceOptionGroup.doc: Specifies the name of the option group from which this option group is copied.

SourceAccountId.doc: Specifies the Amazon Web Services account ID for the option group from which this option group is copied.

CopyTimestamp.doc: Indicates when the option group was copied.

Marker.doc: An optional pagination token provided by a previous request. If this parameter is specified, the response includes only records beyond the marker, up to the value specified by MaxRecords .

rds.ListTagsForResource.doc: Lists all tags on an Amazon RDS resource. For an overview on tagging an Amazon RDS resource, see Tagging Amazon RDS Resources in the Amazon RDS User Guide or Tagging Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS Resources in the Amazon Aurora User Guide .

TagList.doc: List of tags returned by the ListTagsForResource operation.
